summary: A shared admin submenu: one pill row of sibling admin routes on `/admin/start` and `/admin/console`, with `aria-current` decided server-side from the route each page knows, and the rows in `data/admin/submenu.ts`.
reader_impact: An operator can now move between the admin landing and the console it points at without the header menu; both screens keep their gates, no page changed, and `/admin` still answers 404.
